item.name: Phone
item.unlock: No purchase. Offers appear on their own while you play.
item.voidEventNote: Does not stack with the Void Event 4.2x income-source speed.
item.resetNote: Pays nothing after Rebirth until Lemon Stand is earning again.
item.bestUse: Accept when you need cash. Raise a low offer by 10-50% if you want more, but stop before a failed raise cancels the deal. A settings toggle can hide these popups.
item.cardSummary: Phone is a free popup deal. A messenger offers cash based on your current income rate, and you can accept, try a 10-50% raise, or decline.

item.name: Cash Bags
item.unlock: No purchase. Bags spawn during play.
item.location: Central flat map and the first three income sources. Not on the hill, LemonX, or The Staircase.
item.voidEventNote: Does not stack with the Void Event 4.2x income-source speed.
item.resetNote: Pays nothing after Rebirth until Lemon Stand is earning again.
item.bestUse: Sweep the flat starting area when a sky beacon is up. Low graphics can hide the beam, so check the ground around Lemon Stand, LemonDash, and Lemon Depot.
item.cardSummary: Cash Bags are walk-over pickups with a sky beacon. Each bag pays a random 10x to 30x of your income per second on the low, early part of the map.

item.name: Fruit Trees
item.unlock: No purchase. Trees sit around the tycoon.
item.location: Fruit trees on your tycoon and other players' tycoons
item.scalesWith: Current income per second, with a 1 IPS floor
item.boosts: Expert Picker up to x8. Friend Bonus does not apply.
item.voidEventNote: Does not stack with the Void Event 4.2x income-source speed.
item.resetNote: Still pays after Rebirth because the formula uses max(1, income per second). This is the Active Income exception.
item.bestUse: Click shining fruit first, then clear nearby trees while traveling. Buy Expert Picker if fruit picking is already part of the run. Picking a fruit on another tycoon removes it for everyone.
item.cardSummary: Fruit Trees are click-to-pick cash on the tycoon, not Orchard plots. A normal fruit pays 0.5x IPS and a shining fruit pays 5x IPS, both multiplied by Expert Picker up to x8.

item.name: Cosmic Cash Vine
item.unlock: Sewer Key gate in The Sewers
item.voidEventNote: Does not stack with the Void Event 4.2x income-source speed.
item.resetNote: The unlock stays after Rebirth, Evolution, and Ascension. The claim still pays from current income, so it is empty until the stand is earning again.
item.bestUse: Open the sewer gate once, then claim the vine whenever the 4-hour timer is up. Use the Sewer Key and Sewer Maze pages for the route, not this catalog.
item.cardSummary: Cosmic Cash Vine is a sewer claim that pays 30 minutes of your current income every 4 hours. The gate stays open after later resets.

item.name: Lemon Dash, the Game
item.boosts: Cheering your ball slightly raises its win odds.
item.voidEventNote: Does not stack with the Void Event 4.2x income-source speed.
item.resetNote: Pays nothing after Rebirth until Lemon Stand is earning again.
item.bestUse: Play it when the ready popup appears. Pick a ball, cheer during the race, and treat 3rd place as still worth the cooldown. 4th place pays nothing.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Dash, the Game is a four-ball race button at LemonDash, not the LemonDash delivery building. 1st, 2nd, and 3rd pay 60x, 30x, and 15x income per second, then the minigame waits 5 minutes.

item.name: Lemon Trading, the Game
item.scalesWith: Starting coin value is tied to current income per second
item.boosts: Latest News shows whether the coin price is rising or falling.
item.voidEventNote: Does not stack with the Void Event 4.2x income-source speed.
item.resetNote: Pays nothing after Rebirth until Lemon Stand is earning again.
item.bestUse: You start already holding coins, so sell first while the price is high, then buy low and sell high. Leave the market before the end-game collapse or the round pays nothing.
item.cardSummary: Lemon Trading, the Game is a buy-and-sell coin minigame at Lemon Trading, not the trading building's market loop. Finish in cash before the price collapses, then wait 5 minutes.
